title: [AI Codemod][PerfAICT] Add memcpy fast-path for same-dtype dense CPU tensor copies (#197590)
body:
Summary:

This diff is created by PerfAICT to optimize hot code paths while preserving existing behavior.

### Optimization Details

Added a fast path to `at::native::copy_impl` (in both the fbcode and xplat copies of `caffe2/aten/src/ATen/native/Copy.cpp`) that performs a single `std::memcpy` instead of building a `TensorIterator` and dispatching through `copy_stub`. The fast path fires only when the copy is provably a byte-for-byte move: the two tensors have distinct (non-aliased) storage, the same scalar dtype, are both on CPU and non-quantized, have equal sizes, matching `is_conj`/`is_neg` flags, and identical dense memory layout (both default-contiguous, or `self` is non-overlapping-and-dense with strides equal to `src`). In that case it copies `numel * itemsize` bytes (guarded by `numel > 0`) and returns `self`, avoiding the per-call TensorIterator build/teardown, config/operand setup, dispatch-stub lookup, and iteration-loop machinery. All other cases fall through to the original code path unchanged. Also added `#include <cstring>`.
